review:
Get the CHEESE is a cluster slot full of mice, using Hacksaw's Super Cascades, where every symbol of a winning type is removed. A cheese symbol in a winning cluster goes further, clearing the whole grid except FS symbols and wild multipliers.

Those wilds jump to a new position after every cascade. Normal ones start at 1x and add +1x per jump, and Epic ones start at 10x and add +10x, with up to four on the board at once. A long cascade with an Epic wild hopping around is how you reach the 10,000x maximum.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
